summary: Birks Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of a new five-year, $32.5 million senior secured term loan facility with an affiliate of Gordon Brothers, refinancing its existing $26 million term loan. Concurrently, it amended and extended its $93 million senior secured revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo to June 2031, and amended a $3.75 million loan from shareholder Mangrove Holding S.A. to the same maturity. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change occurred. This is a routine refinancing and extension of credit facilities, not a special situation.
